title: Scenes From the 2026 Beijing World Humanoid Robot Games
description: The 2026 World Humanoid Robot Games have begun. 666 teams from around the world are competing with more than 2,000 humanoid robots. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia Customers Notified About AI-Related Price Hikes Above 15%
description: Some of Nvidia Corp.’s biggest customers have been told that the prices of servers containing its artificial intelligence chips are going up more than 15% in many cases with memory chip costs soaring.

title: Apollo’s Slok Says AI Weighs On Pay Without Cutting Jobs — Yet
description: Torsten Slok found something surprising when Apollo Global Management Inc. looked at how the adoption of artificial intelligence was playing out in the labor market.
